review_evidence: README identifies LeanTeX as a Lean 4 library for pretty-printing expressions as LaTeX.

Direct inspection of production modules found expression pretty-printing, syntax/command elaboration, widget code, LaTeX token/data structures, and printer configuration; no theorem/lemma/axiom development specifies or verifies the printer.

The only proposition examples found are two tactic/widget regression fixtures in test/widget_basic.lean, both exercising texify and using sorry rather than constituting an independent mathematical development.

source_action.content_invariant: Production source implements pretty-printer data, rules, elaboration, widgets, and command plumbing without a checked correctness theory; the only proposition examples are texify regression fixtures, so retirement hides no unique mathematical statement, proof, formal specification, or verified semantics.
